title: POV micro-skit
one_liner: A native white-pill "POV:" line while you act out a moment your clients know, then one hard punch-in on your reaction.
best_for: Playful personalities and service providers acting out client moments people recognise
pace: 5-15 s; setup then reaction, nothing after (demo 5.0 s, reaction slowed to 0.5x)
signature_moves: Native Instagram white-pill POV line on screen from frame 0
Hard 130% punch-in on the face for the reaction, slowed so it lands
One 3D emoji springs in beside your head, never over your face
